title: kbext.py reads the settings layers' files through kbsettings._layers, a name that starts with an underscore, because kbsettings has no public reader of them
goal: kbsettings.py holds a public function that returns each settings layer with its file and object, kbsettings.layered and effective call it, and kbext.py calls it instead of kbsettings._layers, so no module reaches a name that starts with an underscore (kb/_self/code.md, Imports)

run: import re,sys; sys.exit(1 if re.search(r'kbsettings\._', open('_tools/kbext.py', encoding='utf-8').read()) else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is an import-direction rule of kb/_self/code.md (no use of another module's underscore name); no behaviour differs, so only the source text shows it
